::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Chennai startup founded 2021. Its VIHAAN-I broadband SoC, built on C-DAC's VEGA RISC-V core and fabricated at UMC 28nm, taped out in January 2026 and reported first-pass silicon success in August 2026; production tape-out targeted for 2027. About 60% of the chip is licensed IP. Raised about ₹40 crore in 2026, including ₹20 crore from Tamil Nadu's Emerging Sector Seed Fund.
:::

## What does this firm design?

GPON/EPON optical network terminal SoCs integrating compute, broadband access and system control.
